expectations.evidence: The rewrite says the platform team "spent the next few months working on it," a time span the original never states (it only gives January and the current p95 figures).
No em dash connectors, cliches, or staged reveals appear. "The result?" and the uplifting "Wrapping Up" paragraph are gone, and "game changer" shows up only in the quoted retro line.
The prose is plain and concrete, with sentences of varied length, e.g. "Most of that time wasn't spent compiling. It was spent downloading the same dependencies on every run."

It stays a straightforward engineering team post with sections, a code block, and a retro quote, and it is neither hype nor a bare bullet list ("Three of the 11 services accounted for 70% of build time, so we started with those.").
